title: National Parks
description: Famous national parks worldwide with their location, size, and notable features.

results.name: Yellowstone National Park
results.notable_feature: Geothermal geysers including Old Faithful and abundant wildlife.

results.name: Yosemite National Park
results.notable_feature: Granite cliffs like El Capitan and Half Dome, and giant sequoias.

results.name: Grand Canyon National Park
results.notable_feature: A mile-deep canyon carved by the Colorado River.

results.name: Banff National Park
results.notable_feature: Turquoise glacial lakes and Rocky Mountain peaks.

results.name: Jasper National Park
results.notable_feature: Largest park in the Canadian Rockies, known for dark-sky stargazing.

results.name: Torres del Paine National Park
results.notable_feature: Dramatic granite towers, glaciers, and Patagonian steppe.

results.name: Iguazu National Park
results.notable_feature: The vast Iguazu Falls system on the border with Brazil.

results.name: Serengeti National Park
results.notable_feature: The great wildebeest migration across endless plains.

results.name: Kruger National Park
results.notable_feature: One of Africa's largest reserves, home to the Big Five.

results.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
results.notable_feature: Big-cat country and northern end of the wildebeest migration.

results.name: Fiordland National Park
results.notable_feature: Deep glacier-carved fjords including Milford Sound.

results.name: Kakadu National Park
results.notable_feature: Ancient Aboriginal rock art, wetlands, and crocodiles.

results.name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
results.notable_feature: A cascade of terraced lakes linked by waterfalls.

results.name: Swiss National Park
results.notable_feature: The Alps' oldest national park, a strict wilderness reserve.

results.name: Vatnajokull National Park
results.notable_feature: Europe's largest glacier, with ice caves and volcanoes.

results.name: Sarek National Park
results.notable_feature: Roadless Arctic wilderness of peaks, glaciers, and valleys.

results.name: Etosha National Park
results.notable_feature: A vast salt pan and waterholes teeming with wildlife.

results.name: Galapagos National Park
results.notable_feature: Endemic wildlife that inspired Darwin's theory of evolution.

results.name: Manu National Park
results.notable_feature: Amazon biodiversity hotspot spanning Andes to rainforest.

results.name: Tikal National Park
results.notable_feature: Ancient Maya temples rising above dense jungle.

results.name: Komodo National Park
results.notable_feature: The wild habitat of the Komodo dragon.

results.name: Chitwan National Park
results.notable_feature: One-horned rhinos and Bengal tigers in lowland jungle.

results.name: Jim Corbett National Park
results.notable_feature: India's oldest national park, a Bengal tiger stronghold.

results.name: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
results.notable_feature: Towering quartzite sandstone pillars rising through mist.

results.name: Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park
results.notable_feature: Encompasses Mount Fuji, hot springs, and the Izu coast.

results.name: Snowdonia National Park
results.notable_feature: Rugged Welsh mountains crowned by Mount Snowdon.

results.name: Cairngorms National Park
results.notable_feature: The UK's largest national park, with high Scottish plateaus.

results.name: Sagarmatha National Park
results.notable_feature: Home to Mount Everest and Sherpa mountain culture.

results.name: Tongariro National Park
results.notable_feature: Active volcanoes and the famous Alpine Crossing trek.

results.name: Denali National Park
results.notable_feature: Denali, the highest peak in North America, amid subarctic wilderness.
